column1: # Devil May Cry (Switch, 2019; Capcom's "Barashi" port of the PS2 game, SDK 6.4.2), base game v0.
# main loads the PS2 data files (dmc1/pld, emd, fsd, ...) with a .prd suffix and draws through NVN (181 of the 512 NVN functions it loads are called).
# subsdk0 is NVIDIA's multimedia library (H.264 / AAC decoders) behind the movie player; the cutscenes are dmc1/video/*.mp4.
# Values copied from other profiles are not measured for this game yet
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. Partition values as Hades until measured
# All 81 BNSH stages are embedded in main

column2: Devil May Cry: BNSH embedded in main
